description: Where bitcoin's price sits on the rainbow chart right now: today's live price, the trend line value for today, the band name (Deep Blue up to Red, or below/above the ladder) and which of the nine bands it is (band 1 is the lowest), that band's dollar range for today, the distance from the line in percent, the counted share of all priced days spent in that band (a count of past days, not odds), a link to the rainbow chart picture drawn from the same live data, and the fit behind the line (its equation, the window of closes it was fit on, and its fit score), all in plain English. The line is a log regression through all daily closes since 2010. It prints the spot price with its UTC quote time (one shared quote per minute across the tools, so its numbers reconcile with simulate_dca's) and states the day the price history runs through: the history can end a few days before today while the price itself is live spot. Descriptive only: it reports the picture, it does not advise buying or selling and does not predict prices.
name: rainbow_today
title: Bitcoin rainbow today
